name: us-augusta-rule-home-rental-to-your-business
description: Renting your home to your own S corporation, C corporation or partnership for meetings under the Augusta rule (section 280A(g)) for tax year 2026 - the exclusion when the home is rented for less than 15 days in the year, why sole proprietors and disregarded single-member LLCs get no deduction, the payer's section 162 test, fair rent, the day count across all renters, the home office conflict under section 280A(c)(6), Form 1099-MISC at the 2026 threshold of $2,000, and the records to keep. Trigger on "Augusta rule", "rent my home to my business", "280A(g)", "14-day rental", "S corp rent my house for meetings". Federal only.
